rule: Gold = the library mode matching the root-cause statement on RCA slide 7/11. Written before any LLM diagnosis run; never edited after seeing results.

PU-2101B.rca_root_cause: Premature mechanical seal failure caused by intermittent dry-running: suction cavitation during feed swings reduced NPSH and seal-flush flow dropped below the 6 L/min minimum, with no interlock to protect the seal.

KO-3201.rca_root_cause: Journal-bearing babbitt distress caused by degraded oil-film strength from water ingress via a leaking lube-oil cooler tube, undetected due to absence of online water-in-oil monitoring, leading to rising vibration and a high-high trip.

PM-4405B.rca_root_cause: Motor drive-end bearing failure caused by grease degradation from an over-extended, non-risk-based re-lubrication interval, undetected due to absence of bearing-temperature trending, resulting in bearing overheating and motor trip.

HE-3301.rca_root_cause: Accelerated tube-side coke/polymer fouling driven by higher-than-design feed heavy-ends, allowed to progress by the absence of a dP-based cleaning trigger and fouling KPI, causing duty loss, high dP and a forced rate cut.

BL-5702.rca_root_cause: High vibration from coupling misalignment aggravated by soft-foot and an over-aged elastomer coupling element, undetected because periodic alignment/soft-foot checks were absent from the PM and the vibration route interval was too long.
